hooks.command: if [ ! -f apps/mobile/.env.local ] || [ ! -d node_modules ]; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:"This worktree is not set up: apps/mobile/.env.local or node_modules is missing, because git worktree add brings only tracked files. Run ./scripts/setup-worktree.sh before running the app, the tests or the e2e suite. Without .env.local the app throws EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is not set at module scope, which surfaces as three misleading expo-router errors."}}'; fi

paths=$(git status --porcelain -- apps/server/src apps/mobile/src 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$paths" ]; then out=$(./scripts/check-adrs.sh 2>&1); s=$?; if [ $s -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg reason "$out" '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'; fi; fi
